honest_statement: At 64x64 resolution, the classical sparse direct solver is vastly faster than FNO on CPU: 0.501 ms vs 20.477 ms single-query (40.9x faster), and 0.255 ms vs 5.590 ms batched (21.9x faster). Even rebuilding and re-factorizing the sparse matrix from scratch on every query (10.925 ms) is ~1.9x faster than FNO (20.477 ms) on CPU, 64x64. The classical solver is faster, exact, and zero-parameter at this scale.
